text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haunted by Symboli Rudolf's "voice" in her 
head, Sirius Symboli lets victory in the 
Nippon Derby slip through her fingers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Waiting for her back at the academy was an 
invitation asking if she would accompany 
Symboli Rudolf as her travel partner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Weighing the pros and cons, Sirius Symboli 
swallows her pride and agrees. Amidst the 
rapidly shifting circumstances, she found 
herself aiming for the Kikuka Sho.
